interpretation.ceg: Each evolving method minus baseline on paired complete campaigns.
interpretation.sue: State-on minus state-off on the same frozen checkpoint, scenario, and execution seed.
interpretation.execution_cvar: Score-loss CVaR across repeats of one frozen state and scenario.
interpretation.environment_cvar: Score-loss CVaR across probe scenarios for one frozen state.
interpretation.path_cvar: CVaR of campaign-level degradation from checkpoint zero on common probes.
interpretation.cvar_tail_0_2: Mean loss in the worst 20% probability mass (equivalent to confidence-level CVaR at alpha=0.80).
interpretation.cvar_tail_0_1: Mean loss in the worst 10% probability mass (equivalent to confidence-level CVaR at alpha=0.90).
interpretation.forgetting: Peak-to-final score loss computed only on probe episode IDs shared across checkpoints.
interpretation.warning: Small samples are diagnostic only; do not treat pilot CVaR as a tail-risk certificate.
